assessment.summary: This study investigates the link between urban vegetable farming and insecticide resistance in Anopheles gambiae s.l. populations in Benin. Field-collected larvae from Cotonou, Porto-Novo, and Parakou (2005-2007) were reared and tested for susceptibility to permethrin, deltamethrin, and DDT. The study provides genotype counts for the Vgsc L995F (kdr-west) mutation, stratified by bioassay outcome (survivors vs. dead), showing high resistance allele frequencies associated with agricultural pesticide use.
